scope_of_work_and_exclusions: OUR SCOPE OF WORK (INCLUSIONS)
Remove existing ceiling grid and tile throughout the suite, approx. 4,597 SF (D100 Note 2)
Remove existing light fixtures throughout, approx. 58 EA (D100 Note 2)
Remove existing flooring throughout, approx. 4,597 SF (D100 Note 2)
Remove existing gypsum wallboard at the demising walls, metal studs to remain, approx. 221 LF (Addendum 1, D100 Note 6)
Remove existing interior walls and closet partitions, approx. 30 LF (D100 Note 1)
Remove existing doors, frames and hardware, 2 locations (D100 Note 4)
Remove portion of existing storefront, approx. 14 LF (D100 Note 5)
Remove existing water filtering equipment and associated piping and conduit after disconnect by others (Addendum 1, D100 Note 7)
Remove existing mop sink / plumbing fixture after capping below slab by plumber (D100 Note 3)
Remove abandoned electrical devices, boxes, plates and wiring back to the nearest junction box
Remove TV brackets, fire extinguisher cabinets and miscellaneous equipment; turn over owner items as directed
Provide daily clean up of debris generated by demolition activities; leave demolition areas broom clean
Removal and disposal of all construction debris (C&D) created from this work to an approved landfill accepting this debris per city, county & federal codes & EPA regulations.
Pennsylvania prevailing wage rates per Addendum No. 1 (L&I Serial 26-09265), including certified payroll.
All work conforms to state and local code requirements.
ADDED EXCLUSIONS
Capping plumbing below slab, MEP disconnects and make-safe (Divisions 15 / 16 per Demo Gen. Notes).
Paint stripping, mastic removal and grinding of concrete floor (priced as Alternate No. 1); sealing of concrete.
Sanitary trench sawcut and slab removal (priced as Alternate No. 2); excavation, backfill and concrete patch.
Dust control barriers and mall-side protection / barricades (by GC).
Removal of conduit and wiring beyond the nearest junction box or back to panel / source.
Roof openings for mechanical, plumbing or electrical work.
Patching and repair of walls, floors and ceilings; removal and reinstallation of relocated items.
Removal of metal studs at demising walls (to remain per Addendum 1).
